summary: Compass 2.0 Sprint 1 (Assignment Representation) end-to-end tested. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases green across analyze, all FIVE required interpret variants, 'I dont know' escalation to direct teaching + requires_reconstruction on non-derivable demands, weak-response escalation, good-response advancement, restatement→adequate, PATCH edit/restart clear, and confidence/answer no-leak. Frontend: full ?represent flow works — entry → sample → analyze → interpretation → 2-column working view with persistent 6-row Question Map + scaffold panel; 'I dont know' escalates scaffold in place without recreating the map (same demand IDs preserved); response history renders; restart-warning-dialog cancel keeps state, confirm re-opens entry prefilled with the assignment; localStorage compass_rep_session persists session id. No praise, percentages, or leaked thesis/essay observed in any scaffold text.
critical_code_review_comments: assignment_representation.py operation handler: on unsuccessful attempt it sets target.scaffold_level = min(3, max(current, scaffold.level)+1) then regenerates. Correct, but if scaffold_attempts becomes large the level caps at 3 with no exit — consider a fallback to move on after N attempts even at level 3 to avoid infinite loop (currently only 'I dont know' at level 3 keeps looping the same demand).

compare_interpretation / evaluate_restatement rely on LLM returning exact demand ids; there is no defensive log/warning if the LLM invents an id (silently ignored via _demand_by_id None check). Consider logging skipped ids for observability.

generate_scaffold: LLM may return studentTask that lightly teaches the concept at level 2 (observed in practice — 'Comparing means showing how two things differ on the same dimension'). Acceptable per spec (attention_cue/guided allow framing) but worth periodic review to ensure the boundary against writing the answer holds across topics.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test creates its own fresh /api/assignment/sessions. Data left in Mongo has ids prefixed asg_ / dem_ — safe to ignore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full assignment_representation coverage lives in /app/backend/tests/test_assignment_representation.py (parametrized over 5 interpretation variants). Suite takes ~6 min (each step is a synchronous Sonnet 4.6 call). Reuse as regression. Frontend happy path via ?represent, testids listed in AssignmentRepresentation.jsx. Adequate→Knowledge UI path was not exercised in browser (backend covers adequacy transition; UI panels are simple state renders).
